body:
**Note (correctness): isVisible() probe may lag right after dock.show(), risking repeated show**

The ADR itself notes `app.dock.isVisible()` can lag after `DockShow`. If a re-assertion (e.g. recording stop followed closely by `applyDockPolicy()`/`⌘⌃O`) lands in that window, the probe reports not-regular and the setter calls `app.dock.show()` again on an active app. That is the window-churn this cache was introduced to prevent. The ADR calls this theoretical because `setActivationPolicy` runs synchronously first. It is untested against real AppKit, so keep it on the owner QA list (rapid start/stop and camera toggles).

**Note (adr): ADR 0029 status differs between the index and the ADR page**

The index lists 0029 as "Proposed — implemented, owner QA pending". The ADR page's status row says "Implemented on `fix/dock-lost-after-floating-panels`; owner QA outstanding". It also names a branch, which will go stale after merge. Use one status vocabulary in both places and drop the branch name.

Measured rather than argued, on Electron 39.8.10 against real AppKit (a throwaway script creating the same windows): `app.dock.isVisible()` reads `true` immediately after `app.setActivationPolicy("regular")`, before `app.dock.show()` runs, and stays `true` at 1, 5, 20, 100 and 300 ms. The lag Electron documents is the transform it dispatches 1 ms later inside `DockShow`; the setter calls `setActivationPolicy` first, so a re-assertion landing in that window sees cache and probe agree and touches nothing — a repeated `dock.show()` cannot come from the probe. The same run confirmed the cause (a plain window joining full-screen Spaces without the flag flips the probe to `false` at once) and the recipe (a `panel` with the flag leaves it `true`). Recorded in bda1ea95: the ADR now states the measurement instead of calling the window theoretical, and the backlog QA list gains the rapid start/stop and camera-toggle step you asked for.
Fixed in 17eb1cbf: both the index row and the ADR status row now read "Proposed — implemented in #366, owner QA pending"; the branch name is gone.
